name: camera
description: An original squircle camera with progressively turning body corners, a shallow raised housing and a circular lens in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Camera-only original squircle trial, 2026-10-28. Semantic brief: a horizontal camera body, low integrated raised housing, circular lens and small indicator. Independently authored from these functional features; no external collection geometry or proportions used. The body uses quintic corner transitions with zero curvature at straight joins, growing toward the diagonal and receding into the next side. Corner control distances are .32 and .64 of their local spans; body shoulder spans3 and lower spans4.5. This is a Camera trial, not a universal approved grammar. Roof uses a separate monotone quintic shallow rise, y7.25 to4.5, with zero end curvature. All parts are symmetric about x12; outer visible bounds x2..22/y3.625..20.375 at Regular1.75, native100/100 and0deg. Lens remains a meaningful circle at12,13/r3.35; indicator18,10.15. Outline uses1.75, Thin1.25/Bold2.50 remain available. Filled exterior is a .875 analytical outward normal offset of the same body, fitted with piecewise cubic Hermite curves with maximum position error .0001 unit. Filled intentionally keeps a circular lens counter at the shared lens centerline radius3.35 for solid-style readability and a .875 indicator counter. No frame added. Stable body/lens/indicator Outline part names preserved; Filled remains one evenodd body with holes. Camera is not a current morph endpoint. Both styles await owner visual review; all other drawings stay approved.
